title: breferrari/obsidian-mind
friendlyTitle: Obsidian Mind gives coding agents a memory in Markdown
summary: A self-organizing Obsidian vault that gives coding agents a persistent, linked memory layer. The current project supports Claude Code, Codex and Gemini workflows and includes templates, hooks and conventions for maintaining the vault.
friendlySummary: The project helps AI coding tools save and organize useful project knowledge inside an Obsidian vault.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to preserve project decisions and session knowledge in readable Markdown instead of depending entirely on a model’s chat history. Review the hooks and permissions before connecting it to a working vault.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when you want future coding sessions to find earlier decisions and notes without keeping one very long chat.
